text_5aaa70a46011: Unknown sections are grey (#4A4A4A). Up to 180 days since the latest trip, Acquiring is blue (#436EEE) until at least two trips in each direction; then Route qualified is light green (#7cfc00). From 181 to 365 days, Ageing is orange (#FF8C00); after 365 days, expired is red (#FF0000). The latest matched GPS trip date in either direction is used, in Berlin calendar days. Viewing alone never renews a date. Confirmed imported qualification keeps priority over GPS.
text_57cc4a68827f: If an older view has no journey date, the GPS track stays blue and is not treated as freshly green. Update the server too and choose Load routes to retrieve the stored GPS timestamps. Original GPS data remain unchanged.
text_24bb17956723: Untravelled routes black; last journey over 180 days orange and over 365 days red. Journey dates from GPS timestamps; blue/green still apply up to 180 days.
